text:
jordan: Quick UX check debating pill selector vs dropdown for notification channels in the Alerting / SLO panel. Figma link: https://figma.com/file/xyz. Pills give quick visibility but blow width. dropdown is compact but hides badges. thoughts? emily: I prefer pills if we collapse extras to '+N' and show icons. users want to see at-a-glance channels in the preview. marco: agree, but if pills we must make keyboard nav crystal. use role=\"listbox\" and option semantics. example: ```
``` emily: also the suppression indicator needs to be explicit in the preview (snoozed vs muted). propose a dimmed pill with a :zzz: micro-icon and tooltip 'Suppressed until 10:00 UTC'. jordan: good. small copy nits: current threshold helper 'percentage of errors' -> 'Percentage of requests failing (last 5m)'. shorter and clearer. marco: a11y: our warning color falls under 4.5:1 for 12px text. will post palette tweaks. aria-bot: Accessibility reminder: preview modal must set role=\"dialog\" , aria-modal=\"true\", trap focus, and announce with aria-live polite. emily: mobile layout: stepper control bumps label; add 6px left margin under 480px. jordan: plan: emily updates figma with pill + dropdown variants, marco will open a PR for keyboard semantics and aria attrs, I'll coordinate color pass with design and prod for rollout notes. thanks :thumbsup:
